Diablo 4 Warlock Build (Brimstone Apocalypse) Lord of Hatred Build Guide
In this Diablo 4 build guide, I'm going to be showing you the Brimstone Apocalypse Warlock Build. This is a hellfire Warlock that uses Hellfire skills to inflict massive AoE damage. Clearing mobs quickly and whether you're running a fresh Warlock Class or jumping straight into the endgame. This Warlock build can reliably deal damage with most enemies up to torment 1 or 2, and has the potential to scale quite well into the higher torment tiers once you've obtained better gear and paragon points.
